description: This file contains integration tests for searching savings account transactions with various filters, sorting, and pagination in the Apache Fineract project. It tests different scenarios including amount and date filters, transaction types, sorting orders, and input validation.

classes.name: SavingsAccountTransactionsSearchIntegrationTest
classes.description: Contains integration tests for searching savings account transactions with various filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST Assured, request/response specifications, and helper instances before each test.

methods.name: testSavingsTransactionsSearchAmountFrom
methods.description: Tests searching transactions with a minimum amount filter.

methods.name: testSavingsTransactionsSearchAmountFromTo
methods.description: Tests searching transactions within a specific amount range.

methods.name: testSavingsTransactionsSearchDateFromTo
methods.description: Tests searching transactions within a specific date range.

methods.name: testSavingsTransactionsSearchSubmittedDateFromTo
methods.description: Tests searching transactions by submitted date, considering business date and global configuration for business date enabling.

methods.name: testSavingsTransactionsSearchTransactionTypeDepositAndDefaultSort
methods.description: Tests filtering transactions by deposit type and default sorting order.

methods.name: testSavingsTransactionsSearchTransactionTypesWithdrawAndDeposit
methods.description: Tests filtering transactions by multiple types: deposit and withdrawal.

methods.name: testSavingsTransactionsSearchPaginationAndNoFilter
methods.description: Validates pagination with no additional filters.

methods.name: testSavingsTransactionsSearchTransactionTypeDepositAndSortByAmountAsc
methods.description: Tests filtering by deposit type and sorting transactions by amount ascending.

methods.name: testSavingsTransactionsSearchWithFiltersSortingAndPagination
methods.description: Complex test combining multiple filters, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: testSavingsTransactionsSearchDateValidationError
methods.description: Checks validation error handling for incorrect date format.

methods.name: testSavingsTransactionsSearchTransactionAmountValidationError
methods.description: Checks validation error handling for invalid amount input.

methods.name: createSavingsAccountDailyPosting
methods.description: Creates and activates a savings account with daily posting for testing.

methods.name: createSavingsProductDailyPosting
methods.description: Creates a savings product with daily interest posting and calculation.

methods.name: buildTransactionsSearchQuery
methods.description: Utility method to build query parameters for transaction search API.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets global configurations after each test.
